fixtures.name: Masters Round 3 (Moving Day)
fixtures.score: Cameron Young and Rory McIlroy tied at 11-under (205)
fixtures.outcomeText: Young's 65 erased an eight-shot halfway deficit and created a tie for the final-round lead.
fixtures.recapText: Moving Day lived up to its name: Young surged from eight behind with a career-low Masters round, while McIlroy's 73 brought the field back into the contest.

fixtures.name: Masters Final Round (Sunday)
fixtures.score: Rory McIlroy won at 12-under (276), one shot ahead of Scottie Scheffler
fixtures.outcomeText: McIlroy successfully defended the Masters for his sixth major title.
fixtures.recapText: McIlroy closed with 71 and held off Scheffler's bogey-free 68 by one. The victory made him only the fourth player to win consecutive Masters titles.
